scope: Offline diagnostic only; not running or modifying the full converter main; no new PGM/YAML or robot operation.
input: Original ground-evidence candidate obstacle hit counts, 0.10..1.50m from fitted floor, 0.05m XY grid.
limitations: Filtering small clusters cannot generally merge thick or displaced walls.
Removed clusters are not ground-truth-confirmed noise; real small obstacles may also be removed.
The complete car script still initializes every other cell as free and does not perform height filtering.
No native ROS map loading, localization, or motion test.
